name: TOB Google OAuth Token
description: Single, app-wide Google OAuth connection for the Social Intelligence Center's private-data sources (YouTube Analytics + GA4 website analytics) — see social/google_oauth.py. Only ever one row: this app connects one ministry Google account, not per-admin connections. YouTube's own public channel-summary card (social/youtube.py) does NOT use this — that's a plain API key, since subscriber/view/video counts are public data needing no consent.
